# Source freshness — 17 November 2026

This inventory distinguishes a fresh download from semantic validation. Existing sources that were not re-fetched remain **review pending**. No claim that the entire UAEU corpus is current is made. The shared SQLite search file was opened read-only; removal below means a runtime public-retrieval/citation exclusion, not erasure of another checkout’s index.

Current college: College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, verified at https://www.uaeu.ac.ae/en/cit/. Current Computer and AI Engineering has two concentrations plus a general pathway. Older Computer Engineering plans remain for explicitly matching cohorts.
